notes: Fixes the Chat YouTube Companion connection test in extension 1.0.3. Chrome can close a one-shot service-worker message channel before a long-running WebSocket probe responds, even when Chat's local bridge is healthy. The tokenless Test connection check now opens ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/ws/companion directly from the extension options page. It still accepts loopback bridge URLs only and sends neither a pairing token nor a bridge secret. This release includes chat-youtube-companion-1.0.3.zip and removes superseded 1.0.2. Update Chat, reload or reinstall the extension, then enter the ws:// bridge address from Chat Settings and test again.
